content:
lee.prod: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: can we get a single timeline doc with owners, soft/hard GA dates, and the conditional gates for API, Console parity, and Optimize?

tara.ceo: Short bullets: API GA (target) = 2024-07-18, Console parity v1 = 2024-08-07, Optimize beta = 2024-06-25. Will publish consolidated timeline by 06/21.

ben.runtime: Runtime callouts: KV-cache + batching are top risk. Proposed canary plan: staging 05/10, limited-prod 5% 05/17, bump to 40% if stable over two weeks. Gate on P99 and error-rate.

zoe.devex: DevEx will produce a canary playbook and migration FAQ by 05/08. Includes example configs and rollback steps.

harry.ops: Ops note: Dedicated capacity tagging + nodepool resize must be done before wide Console rollout. Targeting infra changes 05/14-05/16. If not ready, Console parity shifts by one week.

lee.prod: Can we get explicit thresholds to put in the doc? Sales/support want numbers for customer comms.

ben.runtime: Proposed gates: P95 within +7%, P99 within +6%, error-rate +5% absolute. I'll add baseline values to the timeline doc.

tara.ceo: We'll call July date a public target and commit to a firm announcement by 06/20 after canary review.

zoe.devex: I'll mirror the timeline into docs and add the playbook link when available.

lee.prod: Thanks — please ping here when the timeline doc is live. Marking this thread as captured.
